name_note: GTDB names this genus Ruminiclostridium_E and places in it the species it calls Ruminiclostridium_E siraeum, which papers call Eubacterium siraeum or [Eubacterium] siraeum; its other species are uncultured placeholders.

sentences.text: Eubacterium siraeum is a bacterium detected in faecal samples from a general-population cohort of 913 adults analysed by 16S ribosomal RNA amplicon sequencing.
In that cohort, Eubacterium siraeum was associated with higher sensation seeking and also with more frequent alcohol consumption.
A study reported that the Eubacterium siraeum strain DSM15702 extensively degraded uric acid in vitro, and examined its effects in hyperuricaemic rats.
In a dextran sulfate sodium-induced murine model of ulcerative colitis, Eubacterium siraeum was named among butyrate-producing bacteria enriched after treatment with dihydroartemisinin.
